span.p: 📜 典型端到端任务的 Step 强类型流转全景 (Step Lifecycle)

div.style: color: rgb(30, 64, 175) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
👤 Step 1: USER_INPUT
『修复 README 中的拼写错误并运行单测』

div.style: color: rgb(107, 33, 168) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🧠 Step 2: PLANNER_RESPONSE
模型认知推演 ➔ 决策调用 view_file 检查目标文件

div.style: color: rgb(154, 52, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
⚡ Step 3: TOOL_USE
生成强类型调用: view_file(AbsolutePath='.../README.md')

div.style: color: rgb(22, 101, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
📥 Step 4: TOOL_RESULT
操作系统返回文件切片与行号内容 (耗时 12ms · ExitCode: 0)

div.style: color: rgb(107, 33, 168) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🧠 Step 5: PLANNER_RESPONSE
精准识别拼写错误 ➔ 生成 replace_file_content 原子补丁

div.style: color: rgb(154, 52, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
⚡ Step 6: TOOL_USE
系统拦截并校验唯一性 ➔ 执行局部原子替换

div.style: color: rgb(22, 101, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
💾 Step 7: TOOL_RESULT
物理落盘写入成功 · 磁盘状态与缓存同步更新

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🏁 Step 8: AGENT_EXIT
任务圆满达成 ➔ 输出交付总结与验证成果
